eDNA_index_kenai_plotting %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=Sample_date, y=index_scores, color=ID_mifish, fill= ID_mifish)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1),legend.position = "none",panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size=14), axis.title = element_text(size=18)) + facet_wrap(ID_mifish ~.)+
  geom_smooth() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2021-03-25"), xmax = as.Date("2021-05-01"), ymin = 0, ymax = 1, alpha = .2,fill ="darkred") +  labs(x="Date", y="eDNA Index Score")
